definitions.full: H2766. Charim חָרִם proper name, masculine ( consecrated ; compare Sabean proper name, masculine יחרמאל חרם, Hal 411. 504 DHM l.c .) — 1 priest of the third course , David's time, according to 1Chr 24:8 . 2 priest of time of Nehemiah Neh 10:6 . 3 heads of families of returning exiles : a. Ezra 2:39 = Neh 7:42 ; Ezra 10:21 ; Neh 12:15 . b. Ezra 2:32 = Neh 7:35 ; Ezra 10:31 ; Neh 3:11 . 4 a prince Neh 10:28 .
